paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy values for Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on the MATH-500 dataset by grouping results into five accuracy bins. The horizontal axis shows the Pass@1 range on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with ticks at 0.2 intervals, and the bars correspond to contiguous bins spanning approximately 0.0–0.2, 0.2–0.4, 0.4–0.6, 0.6–0.8, and 0.8–1.0. The vertical axis is labeled “Percentage” and is shown on a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.8 (with evenly spaced tick marks), representing the fraction of samples in each bin (with percentages also printed above the bars). There are five light-blue bars: the 0.0–0.2 bin is labeled 11.2% (height ≈0.112), the 0.2–0.4 bin is labeled 3.4% (≈0.034), the 0.4–0.6 bin is labeled 3.4% (≈0.034), the 0.6–0.8 bin is labeled 5.8% (≈0.058), and the 0.8–1.0 bin is labeled 76.2% (≈0.762). A red dashed vertical line is drawn at approximately Pass@1 = 0.82 and annotated with red text “mean: 0.82,” visually emphasizing the mean value; the bars are presented in increasing bin order from left to right and are not otherwise specially highlighted beyond the percentage labels above each bar.
